house.description: Permissible out-of-state billing for certain disability waiver services clarified.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; clarifying permissible out-of-state billing for certain disability waiver services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+DIRECTION TO COMMISSIONER; OUT-OF-STATE BILLING. +]

[+By December 1, 2025, the commissioner of human services shall submit to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services proposed amendments to home and community-based services waiver plans to include individualized home supports without training, respite, and night supervision in the definition of "direct care staff services" that may be authorized and provided to a waiver participant who is either traveling temporarily out of state or attending an out-of-state postsecondary school. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; clarifying permissible out-of-state billing for certain disability waiver services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. DIRECTION TO COMMISSIONER; OUT-OF-STATE BILLING.

By December 1, 2025, the commissioner of human services shall submit to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services proposed amendments to home and community-based services waiver plans to include individualized home supports without training, respite, and night supervision in the definition of "direct care staff services" that may be authorized and provided to a waiver participant who is either traveling temporarily out of state or attending an out-of-state postsecondary school.
additions: By December 1, 2025, the commissioner of human services shall submit to the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services proposed amendments to home and community-based services waiver plans to include individualized home supports without training, respite, and night supervision in the definition of "direct care staff services" that may be authorized and provided to a waiver participant who is either traveling temporarily out of state or attending an out-of-state postsecondary school.
